findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 evidence command/note does not genuinely exercise the intent premise. The intent specifies k=2, 3 tasks, total=462 cells. The selfcheck (run-driver-selfcheck.mjs line 58-61) runs enumerateCells({tasks:["t1","t2"], k:5}) and asserts 770 cells. Parameters k and task-count both differ from the intent; the cited note does not disclose this divergence. The 462-cell and the exact 3-task shape are never asserted anywhere in the selfcheck. This is a parameter-mismatch honesty violation, not a disclosed deviation.

CHK-001:happy:1 evidence note claims "6 N/A cells" but the intent requires naCells logged count = 3 scenarios × 3 tasks × 2 repeats = 18. The selfcheck runs 2 tasks k=5, so excluded.length=6 (3 scenarios × 2 tasks × 1, since the task dimension differs). The note does not disclose this mismatch; it simply states a 6-cell count without noting the intent stipulated 18. The 18-count assertion with (3 tasks, k=2) is never present in the selfcheck.

CHK-001:edge:0 intent specifies k=1, 3 tasks -> total=231 cells (formula: 1×13×3 + 4×16×3 = 231). The selfcheck only asserts a 1-task k=1 count of 77 (line 90). Neither the 3-task scenario nor the 231-cell total is ever asserted. The evidence note acknowledges "the per-(arm,scenario)×k repeat logic is exercised at the k=1 minimum" but the 3-task boundary required by the intent is absent.
